During the filming of Sinners, Delroy Lindo was given an incredible character introduction as the legendary harmonica player Delta Slim, set inside a meticulously crafted 1930s train station. While blocking the scene, Lindo had a natural actor’s instinct to stand up from the wooden crate he was sitting on and move around the space. However, director Ryan Coogler quickly stepped in and insisted he stay seated, telling the veteran actor, “No, no, no. This is your world.” Lindo later reflected that Coogler was entirely right; remaining firmly planted on the box perfectly projected the character’s quiet power and grounded authority, proving that sometimes stillness is the most dynamic choice an actor can make.

Sinners (2025), written and directed by Ryan Coogler, starring Michael B. Jordan, Hailee Steinfeld, Jack O’Connell, Wunmi Mosaku, Delroy Lindo. In the Jim Crow South of the 1930s, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to leave their criminal past behind and open a juke joint, only to discover a terrifying, supernatural evil lurking in the shadows waiting to confront them.
